display_long_description:
iLauncher is a simple VR app launcher that provides a dedicated 3D launch environment for browsing and opening installed apps.

Users can view all installed apps in one place, and iLauncher can also create a dedicated company app page based on user-provided company information. This makes it useful for enterprise showcases, education, training, medical demonstrations, exhibitions, and multi-app VR projects.

The current version supports app browsing, app launching, a company app page, app uninstalling, and system time adjustment. iLauncher is focused on providing a clean, stable, and easy-to-use entry point for VR content.

Key Features

🌐 Immersive 3D Launcher Space
Browse and launch apps inside a dedicated 3D environment.

📱 All Installed Apps in One Place
View all installed apps in one organized place.

🏢 Company App Page
Create a dedicated page for company-related apps based on user-provided company information.

🧩 App Management
Uninstall apps directly from the launcher interface.

🕒 System Time Adjustment
Adjust system time for managed devices, offline demos, training setups, or fixed-use environments.
